notes: The San Francisco Planning Commission's minutes of its meetings of January - December 2004, from volumes 55 and 56 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (55minutesofsanfran2004san and 56minutesofsanfran2004san). Action minutes, as in 1994 - 2003: each calendar item prints its case number and planner, the property with its assessor's block and lot, the request, the speakers by name, and the action with the vote list and, for most actions other than discretionary reviews, the motion number. This batch was read by an external reader (Meta Muse, working from the Internet Archive's one-file djvu text, which has no page breaks) from a written spec, and converted here: every entry's page was located mechanically in the hOCR page split by its case number, its meeting date and its verbatim quote, with pages dated from each meeting's cover page rather than the running headers. Four kinds of finding: what the Commission decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; what the calendar states stood on or occupied the property; landmark actions; and a dated past fact the calendar prints. A continuance, a motion of intent, a failed motion and an item under 'Items to be continued' are not decisions. The minutes name applicants, owners, neighbours, objectors, commissioners and staff in every item; none of them is in any published field, and every sentence of the reader's notes naming a commissioner was removed on ingest.

coverage.remaining: None that the scans hold. Volume 55 lists a meeting of 17 June 2004 whose minutes are not in the scan, and volume 56 one of 1 July 2004; 29 April 2004 was cancelled. Both stay on the watch list in case they surface out of order.
